changes: Place as_written now gives the actual find-spot (Vanakālī temple, on the base of an image), and normalized is Deopatan rather than the broader 'Kathmandu'
Purpose marked as uncertain: the content is missing, so the dedication of an image is only inferred from the find-spot on an image base and from 'dataniti'

place.as_written: Deupāṭana, Paśupatinath; Vanakālī temple, on the base of an image

purpose: probably the dedication of an image (fragment; content missing)
notes: Very fragmentary: only line 1 is partly legible ('... sānyaḥ krakaśāriḥ somomvacaḥ dataniti'), and line 2 is lost. The editor says 'Fragment, content missing.' Krakaśāri and Somomvaca are unclear and probably corrupt readings. They may be personal names, perhaps of donors, because they come just before 'dataniti' (= dattam iti?). Even so, the 'donor' role is a guess, and these words may not be names at all. '...sānyaḥ' may be the end of a word that is lost. There is no date. Concordance: Kailash 1973, v.1, p.131; DV 187.
